verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is a WebRTC SFU, so simulcast or layered video with per-subscriber bandwidth adaptation is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions simulcast, SVC layers, or bandwidth-based layer selection. The closest item only says the API controls which endpoints publish or receive media, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
